_comment: How far out a shot is, said with its direction: 'shot 4. 9.6, a touch low'.
Read by the engine (voicelines.py) AND the web app (Announcement), so the two always agree.
Bands by the DECIMAL score (ring units, so pistol and rifle read alike): a shot belongs
to the first band whose 'from' it reaches. An inner ten (or < 1 mm) is just 'center'.
{dir} = right, high right, high, high left, left, low left, low, low right.
Each phrase is ONE voice piece: no commas or full stops; letters, numbers, spaces, ' and -.
A word on its own ('low.') sounds wrong, so every phrase has at least two words.
After a change: voice/speak.py export --all (renders only the new pieces, every voice).
